errors.text_span: zwei nebeneinanderliegende Balken (oben hellblau, darunter dunkelblau)
errors.evidence: The German word "nebeneinanderliegende" means side-by-side. The bars for each category are arranged vertically, one on top of the other, as correctly noted in the parenthetical "(oben hellblau, darunter dunkelblau)". The initial structural description is therefore contradictory and incorrect.

For the category "Hindernisse im Zahlungsverkehr", the dark blue bar ("übrige Betriebe") represents a slightly smaller value (approx. 11%) than the light blue bar ("Mindestlohnbetriebe", approx. 12%). The phrase "dunkelblau geringfügig über hellblau" incorrectly states that the value for the dark blue bar is higher.

The description fails to mention that the categories are sorted in descending order based on the values of the light blue bars ("Mindestlohnbetriebe"). The prompt explicitly asks to describe any sorting or ordering.

For the category "Hindernisse im Zahlungsverkehr", the values are approximately 12% for the light blue bar and 11% for the dark blue bar. Describing both as "around 10%" is an inaccurate approximation.
